crossRefs.note: Terah took Abram his son, Lot the son of Haran, his son’s son, and Sarai his daughter-in-law, his son Abram’s wife.…
So Abram went, as Yahweh had told him. Lot went with him. Abram was seventy-five years old when he departed from Haran.
Abram went up out of Egypt—he, his wife, all that he had, and Lot with him—into the South.
They took Lot, Abram’s brother’s son, who lived in Sodom, and his goods, and departed.
The two angels came to Sodom at evening. Lot sat in the gate of Sodom. Lot saw them, and rose up to meet them. He bowed…
and delivered righteous Lot, who was very distressed by the lustful life of the wicked

people.name: Abraham
people.line: Patriarch, chosen by God to father His people

people.name: Haran
people.line: Son of Terah, brother of Abraham and father of Lot.

people.name: Lot
people.line: Abraham's nephew; rescued from Sodom's destruction

people.name: Nahor
people.line: Son of Terah, Abraham's brother; father of Bethuel.

people.name: Terah
people.line: Abraham's father who settled in Haran

translations.web: Now this is the history of the generations of Terah. Terah became the father of Abram, Nahor, and Haran. Haran became the father of Lot.
translations.bsb: This is the account of Terah. Terah became the father of Abram, Nahor, and Haran. And Haran became the father of Lot.
translations.kjv: Now these are the generations of Terah: Terah begat Abram, Nahor, and Haran; and Haran begat Lot.
translations.asv: Now these are the generations of Terah. Terah begat Abram, Nahor, and Haran. And Haran begat Lot.
